rows.en: ＊Amane＊＠０１１＿００５I really get to go too?￥Wow, I'm so happy!!
＊Amane＊＠０１１＿００６I'd decided that if I took first￥place, I'd pick you for sure!
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１２That settles it. The two￥qualified candidates for Project￥Elan have been chosen.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１３The two who qualified now begin￥a month of final preparations.＝＠００１＿０１４Everyone else, your job is to￥support them.＝＠００１＿０１５And one more thing...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１６Tonight we celebrate early.￥Forget rank. Let loose!
－　One Month Later　－＝－　； and Amane Depart　－
＊Amane＊＠０１１＿０２１I'm a little nervous, but￥I'll do my best!＝＠０１１＿０２２Whatever I lack in skill, I'll￥make up for with hard work!＝＠０１１＿０２３Besides, I'm not alone.￥With you, I know we'll be fine!

＊Amane＊＠０１１＿０２６I'm so, so happy! I get to bring￥the sunflower seeds myself,￥and...＝＠０１１＿０２７I get to go together￥with you, the one I love!￥That makes me so happy!!＝＠０１１＿０２８Right now I wanna say thank you￥to everybody!!

＊Amane＊＠０１１＿０２６I'm so, so happy! I get to bring￥the sunflower seeds myself,￥and...＝＠０１１＿０２９It'll be just the two of us,￥me and you, the one I love!￥That makes me so happy!!＝＠０１１＿０２８Right now I wanna say thank you￥to everybody!!
